answers.expected_answer: Three random pods; lowest numbered in A, next B, next A, all Locked. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 7 Adults.

Remove Objectives requiring more players than present; deal one Personal and one Corporate secretly. First Intruder miniature of any type appearing triggers immediate choice by everyone before resolving its Encounter. Remove rejected card face down unseen. Eggs do not trigger it.
Discard the played card and two additional Action cards face up. Contamination cannot pay costs. Choose one OR effect.
At end of their own round take 1 Light Wound. Passing bars further Actions this Phase and allows discarding any number from hand. No further Fire wounds from later players rounds this turn.

Reveal Room and Exploration token; set counter to token number except Nest/Slime Room; resolve effect and remove Exploration token from game. Roll Noise in empty Room unless Silence or Danger exploration cancels it. Occupied Room (Character or Intruder) gives no movement Noise roll.

Cost 2 Action cards; replaces post-movement Noise roll with placing Noise in a chosen connected Corridor. Forbidden in Combat or when all destination Corridors have Noise. Closed Doors block player movement; no miniature stops in Corridors.

Resolve Encounter: remove all connected Noise including Technical Corridors; draw bag token; place matching Intruder; compare token number to all cards in triggering hand including Contamination. Fewer cards causes Surprise Attack against triggerer, equal or more does not. Set token aside.

Move all neighboring Intruders not in Combat into current Room. If none eligible, put Noise in each connected Corridor lacking it including Technical Corridors. Moving Intruder into occupied Room is Combat, not Encounter. Slime converts Silence Noise/exploration results to Danger.

Encounter replaces connected Noise in every Corridor; return Blank; add Adult only if Blank was last token in bag and a spare Adult is available; no miniature or Surprise Attack. Development always attempts adding one available Adult then returns Blank.
Both stay in original Room and destroy Door simultaneously. Destroyed Door permits movement but cannot close except Plasma Torch. Noise-triggered appearance ignores Closed Door.
Remove miniature, discard injuries, return matching token to bag; keep Noise. Characters barred except Mechanic Technical Corridors card and Technical Corridor Plans Item; Doors never placed there.

Both cost 1 Action card against target in same Room. Shoot needs Weapon in Hand and spends 1 Ammo; normal two-hit deals 2 injuries subject to Weapon. Melee draws Contamination to Action discard before choosing target, miss causes Serious Wound, two-hit deals only 1 injury.

Larva dies at 1 injury without Carcass. Adult draws one Attack card blood, dies if blood <= current injuries and leaves Carcass. Queen draws two, sums blood and compares same way; any Retreat arrow causes retreat via Event-card corridor number, discard Event, rather than normal numerical resolution.

Pay Movement cost 1, choose neighboring Room. Before moving resolve separate Attack from each Intruder targeting escaper. Death leaves Corpse in starting Room; survival completes move and standard exploration/Noise.

Fewest Action cards in hand; tie First Player or next in turn order. Matching attacker symbol on drawn Attack card means resolve effect; otherwise miss; ignore blood and discard card. Larva draws no Attack card: place miniature on target Character board and give Contamination on top of Action discard.

No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.

Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.

Each injury from Shoot/Melee destroys 1 Egg. Egg melee draws no Contamination and causes no missed-attack wound. Grenade 2 Eggs, Molotov 1; Noise after every destruction attempt including miss. Fire destroys 1 uncarried Egg in Fire Damage. Nest destroyed when all Eggs taken/destroyed; mark Injury in Nest.

Use corresponding Evacuation Room Action cost 2 with unlocked pod and free space, no Intruder or Malfunction; roll Noise first and fail if Intruder reaches Room. Two Character spaces; Objects use none. Enter then launch immediately or wait; launch at first-round start in later Player Phase, voluntary free exit during round, no launch automatically passes. Intruder appearing in Section returns all pod occupants to Room; another boarder may launch immediately.

Engines then Coordinates then Contamination then Objectives. If ship survives to checks: two/three Damaged explodes kills all aboard incl Intruders; non-Earth kills sleepers but ship/Intruders survive, Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. All survivors including launched pod passengers scan all Contamination; any infected triggers shuffle all Action/Contamination draw 4, any Contamination kills else survives. Larva skips scanning and directly does shuffle/draw. Survivors then reveal/check chosen Objective.

All 11 basic tiles face down in 1 slots; five random additional tiles face down in 2 slots, leftovers boxed unseen; random face-down Exploration per tile. Random face-down Coordinates, Destination B, Time green. Each numbered Engine has shuffled Damaged/Working pair face down, top true status. Five Eggs, three random face-down Weaknesses.

Random Help cards 1 through player count with matching Inventories assign Player Numbers; in number order draw two draft cards, reveal, choose one, shuffle other back. Receive board, ringed miniature in Hibernatorium, shuffled 10 Action cards, starting Weapon in Hand fully loaded, two horizontal inactive Quest Items; activate by printed quest then ordinary Items. Player 1 First Player; blue Corpse in Hibernatorium is Character Corpse Object.

At Player Phase start draw to 5, shuffle Action discard whenever required draw finds empty deck; then pass token left except first turn. Actions/Contamination to own Action discard, Items/Event/Attack/Serious Wounds to respective discard piles face up; markers to pools. Search example has explicit face-down return exception.

Time and active Self-Destruct advance, Intruders in Combat attack, Fire Damage, Event card movement then effect, bag development fully resolved before next turn. Move symbol-matching Intruders without Characters in Room via card-number Corridor; ducts remove miniature/return token. Discard Event unless instructed otherwise. Empty Event/Attack decks reshuffle their respective discard piles.

Larva removed replaced by Adult; Creeper removed replaced by Breeder. Adult/Breeder all players in order roll Noise except in Combat then drawn token returned. Queen: Characters in Nest means place Queen and resolve Encounter; otherwise including undiscovered Nest add Egg; return Queen. Fully resolve all triggered Encounters/Surprise Attacks before new turn.

Eight of each; required new placement with no pool marker explodes/loses hull integrity, all aboard including sleepers/Intruders die. Existing same marker means nothing happens; max one per Room. Removed markers return to pools.

Disables Room Action and Computer; Search still works. Never in Nest or Room Covered In Slime. Special Rooms can malfunction; Engine Working/Damaged unaffected and already-hibernating Characters unaffected. Repair cards/Tools can remove marker.

Normal Items hidden in unlimited Inventory, others see backs/colors; used Item shown. Heavy Items/Objects public in two Hands, third requires dropping one. Added Items act as one with base card. Duct Tape combines two Heavy Items into one Hand, never Objects.
Drop freely during own turn no Action; Objects stay in Room, Items discarded/lost. Found Weapon has 1 Ammo versus starting fully loaded, neither exceeds capacity.

Search Action card: draw two matching Room color Red/Yellow/Green, white choose one of three; keep one, rejected face down back into same deck per example. Counter reduced one, zero bars Search except e.g. Scavenging. Special Rooms cannot Search; Blue crafted never Search.

Cost one Action card plus discard two Items with blue component icons matching two grey result icons, choose/take available card not random draw; unavailable cannot build. May inspect deck any time. Antidote, Taser, Flamethrower, Molotov Cocktail.

Initiator pays one Action card; Characters in same Room may agree to exchange Items/Objects including gifts. Cannot exchange Ammo. Pick Up Heavy Object cost one applies Corpses/Carcasses/Eggs, not searched Heavy Items.

Character Corpse, Intruder Egg, Intruder Carcass correspond to three face-down slots. Research matching Object present in Laboratory, carried or uncarried, reveal and leave card on board, Object not consumed. Discovered rules benefit all; anyone can do research for Objective.

Cost two Action cards, Character in matching Room unless explicit special ability, no Combat or Malfunction. Computer icon only significant when another rule references it, unavailable under Malfunction. Fire alone bars neither Room Action nor Search.
Add two Ammo to one Energy Weapon, never Classic Weapons, never above printed capacity.
Dress all Serious OR heal one dressed Serious OR heal all Light. Dress flips/ignores effect but retains Serious count; identical Serious effects do not stack.
Comms Room Action puts Status marker on own Signal space, used for Objectives only. Basic Room so always aboard.
Choose any one Room, remove Fire if present; all its Intruders flee random directions, one Event card drawn per Intruder. Works with no Fire.

Start marker first green, advance one whenever Time moves. Stop removes marker; restart green. Yellow irreversible and unlocks all pods but they can relock. Skull explodes; hyperspace jump with active sequence still destroyed. Cannot start if anyone hibernating.

Any other Yellow Room with no Destroyed Doors in connected Corridors; close every connected Door, mark procedure. Opening any before Player Phase end removes token/cancels. All closed after all players pass kills all Characters/Intruders immediately, remove token and Fire.
Passive at start of new turn draws to six instead of five if Character there and no Intruders; Malfunction disables. No paid Action.
Choose any one Room and individually open/close any connected Doors, need not all same. Destroyed Door cannot close except Plasma Torch.
Check status of all three Engines even if corresponding Engine Room malfunctions; cannot change status from Control Room.
Hatch flips one Pod Locked/Unlocked. Monitoring secretly looks at one unexplored Room tile and its Exploration token, replaces both, may lie.
Entry automatically gives Slime; no paid Action. No Item Counter, never Malfunction. Max one Slime, extra does nothing; Clothes/Shower remove. Shower does not remove Fire and Fire allowed there.

Check Coordinates secretly and replace, may lie and should remember; Set Destination moves marker to chosen track space referring to one of four card destinations. No Set with Intruder in Cockpit; no change after any hibernation; common Room prerequisites apply.

Check secretly top token only may lie. Repairs Action or Tools permits take both tokens secretly restack any order. Need announce whether order changed, not whether repaired. Works without prior check and despite Malfunction. Top true status, two Working needed.

Only Time on blue, functioning Hibernatorium without Intruder; Room Action cost two, Noise roll, appearing Intruder fails. Success remove Character miniature and participation until end checks. Destination change and starting Self-Destruct prohibited. Later Malfunction has no effect on sleepers.

Time final red immediate jump, awake aboard die; Intruders unharmed. Last alive non-hibernating aboard leaves/dies/hibernates: advance active Self-Destruct to final red and destroy ship, else advance Time final red and jump. Then survival/victory checks if survivors.
Never directly attack Characters; indirect harm permitted, e.g. grenade at Intruder with crew present, trap in burning Room, Self-Destruct.
Remove Adults not in Combat and return corresponding tokens to bag if possible, then place Adult in Encounter Room. Moving Intruder into unexplored Room does not reveal Room/token and is not removed.
Small curled symbol hits Larva/Creeper for one only; larger curved hits Larva/Creeper/Adult for one only; other targets missed. Same target restrictions in Melee; miss causes Serious Wound.
No four-card draw unless infected found or Larva on board; end scan does not instruct removing non-infected. Pod passenger still needs surviving Contamination check and chosen Objective fulfillment.

Antidote: flame and medical cross. Taser: battery/lightning and wrench/tool. Flamethrower: flame and wrench/tool. Molotov Cocktail: flame and folded cloth/fabric. Each takes two matching blue-component Item cards.

answers.expected_answer: Sharing Room with Intruder defines Combat, not Eggs. In Combat Only requires Combat, Out of Combat Only requires none. Unmarked may be used in or out of Combat, subject to its other requirements.

X must be dead at game end; need not be killed by own Actions; hibernating or escaping alive is not death. Only survivor means nobody else survives. Own Character must survive by launched Pod or successful hibernation, plus meet Objective.
Take any Door token elsewhere on board and move to required Corridor. Open no token, Closed standing, Destroyed lying. Max one per Corridor; none in Technical Corridors.
